items.name: theme
items.title: AgentBlog reading theme
items.description: A reading-optimised base for a standalone blog site: neutral base colour, a comfortable measure, and generous line height. Intended for a fresh scaffold. `agentblog create` does not apply it yet, so add it by hand on a new project. Never install it into an app that already has a design system: a base carries style, icon library, and base colour, and applying one replaces what is already there.
items.docs: `agentblog create` does not apply this yet. On a new project run `npx shadcn@latest add @agentblog/theme` yourself. A registry base cannot pin the component primitive library; pass `--base base|radix|aria` to `shadcn init` if you need a specific one. The AgentBlog block works with all three, because it composes on your own primitives rather than shipping its own.
